slides.title: Program Performance: Executive Summary
slides.summary: topcashback performance was mixed in Jan 2026 – Apr 2026. Conversions moved +25.0% to 125 and conversion rate moved +25.0% to 5.0%. Publisher commission decreased -7.1% to GBP 650, while digital wallet earnings increased +150.0% to GBP 250. Total earnings ended at GBP 900 (+12.5%) and total order value increased +25.0% to GBP 12,500.

bullets: Conversion Rate Movement: Conversion rate increased +25.0% (4.0% to 5.0%). Conversions increased +25.0% (25), showing how efficiently the publisher converted traffic into outcomes.
Conversion Volume: Total conversions increased +25.0% (25). Largest declining publisher contribution requires confirmation from mover tables.
Order Value: Total order value increased +25.0% (GBP 10,000 to GBP 12,500). Value generation moved alongside conversion volume and earnings performance.
Publisher Commission: Publisher commission decreased -7.1% (GBP 700 to GBP 650). Commission remains the core publisher earning component.
Total Earnings: Total earnings increased +12.5% (GBP 800 to GBP 900). Digital wallet contribution was GBP 250 (+150.0%), so total earnings combine commission and wallet income.
